correctness.rationale: Reconstructed companion trace R_n=tr(A^n), A^22=I+N, N^2 divisible by 23, tr(A^r N^3) divisible by 23^2 for all r via Cayley-Hamilton/recurrence. These ensure 22 restricted analytic branches F_r(t)=R_r+23g_r(t), nonzero quadratic reduction for all r. Every branch has a unique simple critical point and an analytic unit-square change of variable; Hensel isometries lift its other residue classes freely. Independently recomputed quadratic branch table modulo 529: 211 targets, 198 with some simple preimage and 13 critical-only, all unique and disjoint. Hence |I_k|=198·23^(k-2)+13S_(k-3) for k>=3, period 22·23^(k-1), Haar measure 198/529+13/25392=9517/25392. Finite table checks are not the proof of the analytic unrestricted step.
